characters.name: Abram
characters.description: kind thoughtful man, about 55-looking, tall lean build, olive skin, warm brown eyes, long dark-brown beard with grey streaks, cream linen robe under a terracotta-and-brown striped wool mantle, white head-cloth tied with a brown cord, leather sandals, carries a tall wooden shepherd's staff

characters.name: Sarai
characters.description: gentle brave woman, about 50-looking, slim, olive skin, dark expressive eyes with dark eyebrows, warm smile, long deep-blue wool dress, cream head-scarf covering all her hair, a thin silver bracelet on her right wrist

characters.name: Abram's Tent
characters.description: a large tent of dark-brown goat-hair cloth with cream stripes, raised on wooden poles, its side walls rolled up so it is open on all sides, woven rugs and cushions on the ground inside

cover.prompt: Abram and Sarai walk hand in hand along a winding desert path toward green hills at sunrise, seen from a slight angle so their happy, hopeful faces show. Abram holds his staff, a few sheep and two camels follow behind with bundles. The sky glows gold and pink ahead of them. Wide shot, warm inviting light, the couple as the clear focus.

pages.prompt: The town of Haran: flat-roofed mud-brick houses, a well, neighbors chatting in a lane. Abram stands at the door of his house with his staff, Sarai beside him with a jug, a small flock of sheep grazing in the yard. Ordinary, calm daily life. Wide shot, soft morning light, warm beige and terracotta colors.

Evening on the flat rooftop of Abram's house in Haran. Abram stands alone, looking up with wide eyes and one hand on his heart as a soft warm golden light glows down from the clouds onto him, with no figure in it. The town below is dim and quiet. Medium shot from slightly behind and beside him, sense of a gentle, important moment.

Inside the house by an oil lamp: Sarai looks up at Abram with a curious, slightly worried face, and Abram answers with an open, honest expression, palms up. Sarai reaches out and takes his hand with a warm, determined smile. Close-up on the two of them and their joined hands, soft golden lamplight.

Busy packing in the courtyard at dawn: Sarai folds wool blankets into a bundle, Abram ties clay water jugs and a stack of pita bread onto a kneeling camel. Sheep bleat with open mouths, a second camel hums with half-closed eyes. A cheerful, bustling scene. Medium-wide shot, fresh early light.

A long journey through a hot desert: Abram and Sarai lead their small caravan of sheep and two camels over a sandy ridge, tall rocky mountains in the distance. Abram pauses and glances back over his shoulder toward the far horizon with a soft, wistful look, then keeps walking. Very wide shot, the travelers small against the vast landscape, bright hot afternoon light.

Abram's Tent set up beside a rocky path in the late afternoon. Local travelers and shepherds sit on rugs in its shade; Sarai offers them warm bread from a basket and Abram pours water from a clay jug, smiling and talking warmly. Medium shot, welcoming mood, long golden shadows.

Arrival in Canaan: from the top of a hill, Abram and Sarai look out over a wide land of soft green hills, olive groves and a small valley stream. Abram spreads his arms in amazement, Sarai beside him smiling. Warm sunlight breaks through the clouds and falls across the land. Wide shot from behind them, bright hopeful light.

Night outside Abram's Tent. Abram stands just outside the tent opening, head slightly bowed, a quiet and sad look on his face. A soft warm glow surrounds him as he slowly lifts his eyes to a sky that is just starting to fill with stars. Medium shot, deep-blue night with warm light from the tent behind him.

Abram on a small hill at night, head tipped all the way back, pointing up and counting with a delighted laugh. The sky above is completely filled with thousands upon thousands of bright stars and a glowing band of the Milky Way. Wide shot from low behind him, the starry sky taking most of the picture, magical deep-blue light.

Close-up of Abram's face under the stars, lit by soft silver starlight and a gentle warm glow, his eyes shining with happy tears and a deep, peaceful smile, hands pressed to his chest. Countless stars sparkle behind him. Calm, joyful, quietly wondrous mood.

Abram and Sarai sit together on a rug in the opening of Abram's Tent at night, shoulder to shoulder, Sarai's head resting on Abram's shoulder, a small oil lamp glowing beside them. Sheep sleep nearby, the camels rest, and the starry sky stretches over the hills of Canaan. Medium-wide shot, warm cozy lamplight against the cool night.

Morning in Canaan, seen at a child's eye level: Abram and Sarai walk hand in hand along a path between olive trees toward the rising sun, taking a deep breath, both smiling. A few sheep trot ahead of them. Wide shot from behind and slightly to the side, bright fresh golden light, brave and encouraging mood.
